Example Retail Pty Ltd pays $26,640 penalty

Date issued
3 September 2026
Legislation
Australian Consumer Law

Example Retail Pty Ltd (ABN 11 123 456 780) has paid two infringement notices totalling $26,640 issued by the ACCC.

The ACCC had reasonable grounds to believe the company made false or misleading representations in breach of the Australian Consumer Law, Schedule 2 to the Competition and Consumer Act 2010.

The payment of a penalty specified in an infringement notice is not an admission of a contravention.

Source: ACCC (c) Commonwealth of Australia
